After 30+ Years of success in the UK, Entertainment Guarantors is bringing it's model to Malta, for a first of it's kind in the country's history.

Founded in South Africa by Barry Filby and Stanley Roup, with offices now based in USA, South Africa, Malta, Germany and UK, with bonding experience across Hungary, USA, UK, Portugal, Spain, South Africa, Ireland, providing comprehensive risk management and insurance for major international banks and production companies.

Barry, who has been in Insurance his whole working life - initially for Bowring, in London before transferring to South Africa, he carried on working with Bowring, which eventually became Marsh.

He left to launch EG as the first bond company in South Africa which he managed until 2003, doing more than 50 films, budget ranges in South Africa were typically large at this time generally between 10,000,000 and 40,000,000 (adjusted for inflation). EG then proceeded to expand into Australia where the company successfully completed another 30 films.

As the markets changed EG focused more in the UK from 2010 which saw EG issue bonds for ap-EG then proceeded to expand into Australia where the company successfully completed another 30 films. As the markets changed EG focused more in the UK from 2010 which saw EG issue bonds for approximately 50 films. To date, the company has now been instrumental in ensuring that over 150 films have been delivered on time and on budget.

Notably Entertainment Guarantors stringently monitor the process to ensure that any problems are anticipated early and remedial action can be taken by the Bonder to avoid these problems escalating into more serious issues. Our modus operandi ensure a good working relationship with the Producer which the Producer can exploit using our many years of experience without detriment to their vision.

Our completion bonds are insurance products provided directly through Marsh, the world’s largest insurance broker, established in 1905. These bonds include a cut-through clause to Lloyd’s of London, the premier provider in the space, founded in 1686. This partnership leverages over 338 years of combined insurance history and a robust balance sheet, ensuring unparalleled security for your production investments

01

The Completion Bond is a guarantee that a film will be made on time and budget, substantially in accordance with the script and other key elements crucial to the financing.

02

Should the film not be completed and delivered within the contracted time period or exceeds its budget, the Completion Guarantor undertakes to advance the funds needed to complete and deliver the film, or, at their discretion, give the investors their money back.

03

A Bond provides significantly increased protection and increases the probability of banks, financiers and high-net-worth individuals investing in a film.

title: Services
content:
Services and Protection for ALL Film and Television Budgets and Investments

What We Do

We take a hands-on approach with all departments, visiting sets and deploying a consistent monitor of expenditure against budget, focusing on interaction with the finance and production team that also coincides with our ongoing risk management programme.

01

Bond Packages

We offer different options that can allow us to discount the total cost to the production company.

This may provide savings to meet the budgetary constraints and requirements of the producer.

We have a flexible approach to the bonding process which translates to a product tailored to the needs and requirements of the producer and financiers.

Our approach is not just about financial oversight—it’s about strategic collaboration, ensuring productions run smoothly from pre-production to final delivery.

02

Risk Management

We meticulously analyze budgets, schedules, and production risks to offer a tailored completion bond that protects investors.

This service is usually provided on smaller budget films, where the cost of a bond is considered prohibitive, but the financiers require an independent third party to carry out the required due-diligence and monitoring of the production.

We actively oversee productions, working closely with financiers and producers to keep projects on track and on budget.

03

Post-Completion Bonds

This type of bond provides protection in the same manner as a full completion bond but only once filming is completed and the film is ‘in the can’.

The film has probably run out of finances, but needs finishing. Producers will seek to raise additional funds to complete the film and the investors want a guarantee the film will be completed.

04

Tax Credit Only Bonding

Many Banks and Investors will discount Producer’s Tax Credits but require certainty that the film will comply with legislation and that the film is made in accordance with the opinion letter provided by the Auditor on which they base the risk.

As Completion Guarantors we ensure that the spend on the film is made in strict accordance with the budget. We further Guarantee that we will oversee completion of the film to the extent that we will take no action which would jeopardize the Producer’s ability to claim the Tax Cred

Film Insurance

Entertainment Guarantors provides a comprehensive suite of insurance solutions designed to protect film and television productions across every stage of the production lifecycle.

While Completion Bonds remain a core insurance-backed guarantee—ensuring projects are delivered on time, on budget, and substantially in accordance with approved materials—our wider insurance offering extends beyond delivery protection to encompass the broader risk environment faced by producers, financiers, and distributors.

We arrange full Production Insurance coverage tailored to the operational realities of filming, safeguarding productions against unforeseen interruptions, physical losses, and liabilities that can arise throughout development, principal photography, and post-production.

We also provide Errors & Omissions (E&O) Insurance, a critical component for distribution and release. E&O coverage protects against claims relating to intellectual property, defamation, rights clearance, and contractual exposures, ensuring that completed projects can proceed confidently into the marketplace.

Entertainment Guarantors works closely with producers, financiers, and insurance partners to structure robust, internationally recognised coverage that supports secure investment, protects creative vision, and enables smooth delivery and exploitation of film and television assets.

title: Our Team and Partners
content:
Meet the Entertainment Guarantors Team

The Minds Behind Entertainment Guarantors

Timothy Driver

Head of Finance and Structuring

Timothy has arranged in excess of $3 billion of film and television production finance. He is a qualified King’s Counsel, CPA, and international film finance attorney, advising multiple leading bank credit committees. Timothy has more than one million words published in film trade journals on film finance, has pioneered co-production structures with household names including Wētā Workshop, James Cameron, and The Matrix franchise, and has advised film commissions in Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, and multiple US states.

Peter Ropner

Head of Risk Management

Peter is responsible for risk oversight on more than $500 million of investment across the last decade. He brings multi-generational experience from a family office with nearly 100 years of heritage in shipping and insurance, applying disciplined risk control and long-term strategic oversight to structured entertainment finance.

Barry Filby

Founder and Head of Compliance

Barry has spent his entire professional life in insurance, beginning with Bowring in London before continuing his career in South Africa. He founded Entertainment Guarantors as the first bond company in South Africa and has overseen the successful delivery of more than 150 films across multiple international markets, establishing core compliance and delivery disciplines across bonded productions.

Tobi Mathews

Head of Legal

Tobi has overseen production legal work on more than 100 film projects with combined budgets exceeding $500 million. His experience spans the USA, UK, Europe, Africa, and Australia, across co-productions, studio projects, and location filming, providing counsel on financing structures, rights, and delivery obligations.

Joel Hatch

Head of Production

Joel brings senior production management experience across feature films and television, with credits including key production roles on Barb Wire (1996), The Game (1997), and House of 1000 Corpses (2003). He provides operational oversight focused on schedule discipline, cost control, and delivery execution.

Stephen Naulls

Head of Production Accounting

With over 25 years of experience as a freelance production accountant, Stephen heads up the accounting oversight team - ensuring fiscal discipline, budget efficiency, and investor protection across all bonded projects.

Nobert Tavarwisa

Financial Controller and Lead Accountant

Nobert has provided financial control and accounting oversight across dozens of film productions over the last decade, including the hit horror franchise Jeepers Creepers and multiple high-profile films starring Nicolas Cage, Ethan Hawke, and Kelsey Grammer. He has managed corporate filings and financings totaling more than $100 million during the same period, ensuring accurate reporting, compliance, and financial discipline across bonded productions.
